verdict.rationale: Bolna offers no-code agent creation via Agent Studio, templates, and tabbed configuration (language, tools, analytics) and can chain multi-step outreach 'workflows' combining calls, WhatsApp, waits/retries — but those workflows are explicitly 'driven entirely through the Bolna API,' not a drag-and-drop visual canvas, and no evidence shows branching/state diagrams or handoff logic being designed visually. missing for 10: a documented visual flow/canvas editor, branching/conditional node support, explicit state machine or handoff UI, and no-code (non-API) workflow construction.
